# Loop If Condition Is True

Source: [wiki article 4392](../archive/4392.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Loop If Condition Is True](../../api/actions/loop-if-condition-is-true.md).

<a id="wiki-4392-n1"></a>

- Loop If Condition Is True restarts the whole action list if all rule conditions are true; it requires an executed Wait since list start.
